issues.description: The Farm.singFarmSong() method has inconsistent return types across artifacts: the problem statement UML and the template declare singFarmSong() as void (it should print the song), while the solution implementation returns a String (building and returning the song text). The solution also changes the helper singFarmSongVerse(...) to return a String instead of printing (the UML/template indicate a void helper that prints). This mismatch can confuse students about whether they should implement printing behavior (void) or return the song text (String) and may break compatibility between student implementations and the provided reference solution or tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the implementation consistent with the UML and template by changing the solution to use void return types and print the song to System.out. Concretely, modify the solution's singFarmSong() to have return type void and print each verse (instead of returning a String), and change singFarmSongVerse(Animal) to a void helper that prints the verse directly. Alternatively, if returning the song as a String is intentional for testing, update the problem statement UML and the template method signatures to return String and document that singFarmSong() returns the full song text rather than printing it.
